The slides are ready at `/marp-slides/transformer-architecture-business.md`. Here's what was created:

**4 slides (title + 3 content):**

1. **Title Slide** — "Transformer Architecture: The AI Breakthrough Behind ChatGPT & Modern Language Models"

2. **The Problem with Old AI** — Uses an assembly-line vs. parallel-team analogy to explain why older RNN models were a bottleneck. No jargon, business-friendly framing.

3. **How Transformers Work** — Explains self-attention ("AI reads the whole document at once"), multi-head attention ("8 specialist reviewers in parallel"), and positional encoding ("word order stamps") in plain English.

4. **Business Impact & Results** — Real numbers: 10× cheaper training, 3.5 days vs. weeks, +2 point accuracy improvement; positions transformers as the foundation powering GPT, ChatGPT, BERT, and all modern NLP products.

All technical terms are explained inline (e.g., *attention mechanism (the AI's ability to focus on relevant words)*), and the business theme's navy/blue corporate styling is applied throughout.
